title: Core body temperature
text: Measure with the same calibrated device and method each time, at rest. In flight the body runs about 1 °C warmer than on Earth, so the app shifts the personal baseline but never the limit.
39.1 °C or above scores watch and 35.0 °C or below scores critical under NEWS2. Tell the crew medical officer about any amber or red result.

citations.source: NEWS2 (Royal College of Physicians, 2017): single-parameter scores for temperature.
Stahn et al., Scientific Reports 2017: core body temperature rises about 1 °C in long-duration flight.
